meta.name: weekly-digests
meta.description: Generate a serial week-by-week narrative digest of a project's full claude-mem timeline. Splits the timeline into per-ISO-week files, then runs one consecutive subagent per week — each receiving the prior week's carry-forward block — to produce one chapter per ISO week of data. Use when asked for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story", "serial timeline", or "narrative chapters" of a project's history.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目历史按周生成连续叙事回顾
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望把项目记录自动整理成每周连续的叙事摘要
copy.tagline_en: Turn your project timeline into a week-by-week narrative.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want automatic weekly narrative summaries of your project history.

howto.what: Claude 会把项目的完整 claude-mem 时间线按 ISO 周分段,给每个有数据的周生成一章叙事摘要;各章由子代理按顺序撰写,后一章继承前一章的“剧情延续”块,形成连贯的多章故事。
howto.when: 当你提到“weekly digests”“week-by-week story”“serial timeline”等按周叙述的请求时触发;若你只要一篇总览式长报告,它会改用 timeline-report 而不是本流程。

say.text: 把我们这个项目的历史做成 weekly digests。
say.note: 会先取时间线,按周拆文件再逐周写章。

say.text: 按周一章一章讲完这个项目的开发故事。
say.note: 前后章节会通过剧情延续块串起来。

say.text: 这个项目大约只有四周数据,也按周出摘要吧。
say.note: 数据少也能按周输出对应章节。

howto.what_en: Splits a project's claude-mem timeline into per-ISO-week files and writes one narrative chapter per week. Subagents work in order, each receiving the previous chapter's carry-forward block, linking the chapters into one story.
howto.when_en: Triggered when asking for 'weekly digests', 'week-by-week story', 'serial timeline' or similar per-week narrative of a project; for one long report it switches to timeline-report.

say_en.text: Turn our project's history into weekly digests.
say_en.note: Fetches the timeline, splits by week, then writes chapters.

say_en.text: Tell this project's dev story week by week, one chapter per week.
say_en.note: Keeps chapters connected via the carry-forward block.

say_en.text: This project only has about four weeks of data; still make weekly digests.
say_en.note: A short project still gets one chapter per week.
